capabilities: display base notes in a scrollable feed with content
edit note content inline with automatic saving to the source file
sort feed by modified date, created date, or name
open notes from titles or context menus
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.10.0 or later, which at the time of writing is in Early Access and needs a Catalyst license; not yet available in Community Plugins, install via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Adds a feed layout to Obsidian Bases so you can display notes with their content
problem: Obsidian Bases only offers list-like views that show note metadata, so you cannot read and edit note content inline from a base view.
summary: A Bases view type that renders notes as a scrollable, editable feed with content previews.
